description: Per-shipment export checklist template — single source of truth shared by the Python runtime (Agent 6 seeds it via StateManager.seed_logistics_checklist) and the Next.js API (POST /api/shipments seeds it via SQL). Every step is human-toggled: Faith-El never marks a step done on its own, because completing a step happens with EXTERNAL providers and can only be attested by an operator. Tests on both stacks assert the 18-item shape.

entries.title: Container requirement confirmed
entries.detail: Type, quantity, needed-by date and ports agreed from the contract

entries.title: Logistics provider selected
entries.detail: A provider from the directory has been chosen for this shipment

entries.title: Availability checked with provider
entries.detail: Space confirmed with the provider on their official channel

entries.title: Booking placed
entries.detail: Booking made with the provider (their reference obtained)

entries.title: Booking confirmation uploaded
entries.detail: The provider's written confirmation is stored on the shipment

entries.title: Transport to warehouse arranged
entries.detail: Trucking/rail for stuffing organised (segment recorded in Transport)

entries.title: Cargo ready at warehouse
entries.detail: Lots bagged, weighed and staged for stuffing

entries.title: Empty container picked up
entries.detail: Container collected from depot (container record updated)

entries.title: Container sealed
entries.detail: Seal number recorded on the container

entries.title: Shipping order confirmed
entries.detail: Carrier's shipping order (S/O) matched to the booking

entries.title: Bill of lading issued
entries.detail: B/L number recorded on the shipment

entries.title: Shipment tracking active
entries.detail: Tracking reference recorded and being monitored

entries.title: Buyer notified of shipment
entries.detail: Shipping advice sent to the buyer (Inbox)
